question: What did Elijah tell the LORD about himself at Horeb?
options: That he wanted to be king
That he was the only one left, and they were trying to kill him too
That he had defeated all his enemies
That he was ready to go back to Samaria
explanation: Elijah said the Israelites had rejected God's covenant and killed His prophets, and that he was the only one left and they were trying to kill him too.
